title: Privacy Policy
body:
Jumbo Sales ("we", "us", "our") respects your privacy and is committed to handling your personal information responsibly. This policy explains what information we collect when you use this website, how we use it, and the choices you have.

Information We Collect. We collect information you choose to give us directly — for example, your name, phone number and location when you contact us via WhatsApp, phone, or a quote request. We do not require you to create an account or submit payment details through this website. We do not operate a customer database or store your information beyond what is needed to respond to your enquiry and fulfil your order.

Automatically Collected Information. Like most websites, we use analytics tools (Google Analytics) to understand how visitors use the site — which pages are viewed, which products are popular, and general location and device information. This data is aggregated and does not identify you personally. You can control cookie and analytics tracking through your browser settings.

How We Use Information. We use the information you provide to respond to enquiries, process orders, arrange delivery, and improve our product range and service. We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information to third parties.

Third-Party Services. When you contact us via WhatsApp, your message is subject to WhatsApp's own privacy policy, which we do not control. The same applies to any third-party service we link to or use, including Google Analytics and Google Maps.

Data Protection Act, 2019. We aim to handle personal information in a manner consistent with Kenya's Data Protection Act, 2019. If you have questions about how your information is handled, or wish to request that we delete information you've shared with us, contact us using the details on our Contact page.

Changes to This Policy. We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal reasons. The effective date above reflects the most recent update.

Contact Us. For any privacy-related questions, reach us via the phone, WhatsApp or email listed on our Contact page.
